name: Affogato AI
long_description:
Affogato is an AI creative studio for brands, agencies, eCommerce sellers and creators. One account and one credit wallet give you 120+ of the best image, video and voice models, plus studios built for the jobs people actually need done. Swap the cast of any video, turn a script into a talking-head episode, design a custom voice, lip-sync a character to a voiceover, make studio headshots, and upscale to true 8K, all without editing skills. Type an idea and get campaign-ready TikToks, Reels, Shorts and ads in minutes.

Everything in the app is also available to developers and AI agents. A REST API and an MCP server let Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor and your own code run the same models and studios from the same wallet.
one_liner: AI studio for videos, ads and avatars, in your browser or your agent
